map.输入固定成本、单位变动成本、单价与预计销量，测算单位边际贡献、边际贡献率、保本销: Enter fixed cost, unit variable cost, price and expected sales to estimate the unit contribution margin, contribution margin ratio, break-even volume, break-even sales and expected profit, and compare the profit lift from a lower unit variable cost.
map.页面按本量利（CVP）基本公式计算：单位边际贡献 = 单价 − 单位变动成本；边: The page uses the basic cost-volume-profit (CVP) formulas: unit contribution margin = price − unit variable cost; contribution margin ratio = unit contribution margin ÷ price × 100%; break-even volume = fixed cost ÷ unit contribution margin; expected profit = unit contribution margin × expected sales − fixed cost. It then recomputes with the optimized unit variable cost and compares both plans on unit variable cost, expected revenue, total cost, expected profit, cost ratio and break-even volume.
map.定价前测算保本销量：固定成本 60,000 元、单价 50 元、单位变动成本 3: Estimate break-even volume before pricing: with fixed cost 60,000 CNY, price 50 CNY and unit variable cost 30 CNY, break-even volume is 3,000 units, which helps judge whether the pricing and cost structure work.
map.对比降本方案：把单位变动成本从 30 元降到 26 元，保本销量由 3,000: Compare cost-reduction plans: cutting the unit variable cost from 30 CNY to 26 CNY lowers break-even volume from 3,000 to 2,500 units and gives the expected profit lift.
map.教学演示：演示边际贡献、边际贡献率与保本点的关系，理解「销量覆盖固定成本后才产生: Teaching demo: show how contribution margin, contribution margin ratio and the break-even point relate, and why profit appears only after sales cover the fixed cost.
map.使用示例（默认参数）：固定成本 60,000、单位变动成本 30、单价 50、预: Example (default inputs): fixed cost 60,000, unit variable cost 30, price 50, expected sales 5,000, optimized unit variable cost 26. Unit contribution margin 20 CNY, contribution margin ratio 40%, break-even volume 60,000 ÷ 20 = 3,000 units, break-even sales 150,000 CNY; expected profit 20 × 5,000 − 60,000 = 40,000 CNY. With the optimized unit contribution margin of 24 CNY, profit is 24 × 5,000 − 60,000 = 60,000 CNY, a lift of 20,000 CNY, and break-even volume falls to 2,500 units.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的算术估算值，未计税: The tool runs entirely in the front end and never uploads inputs to a server. Results are arithmetic estimates under the formulas above, excluding taxes and multi-product amortisation. When price ≤ unit variable cost the unit contribution margin is not positive, so no sales level breaks even and the page reports "no break-even point". Base real decisions on financial accounting and actual cost data.
map.保本点怎么算？: How is the break-even point computed?
map.保本销量 = 固定成本 ÷（单价 − 单位变动成本）；默认参数下为 60,000: Break-even volume = fixed cost ÷ (price − unit variable cost); with the default inputs it is 60,000 ÷ 20 = 3,000 units, corresponding to break-even sales of 3,000 × 50 = 150,000 CNY. When price is at or below unit variable cost the unit contribution margin is not positive, so no sales level breaks even and the page reports "no break-even point".
map.边际贡献率是什么？: What is the contribution margin ratio?
map.单位边际贡献 ÷ 单价 ×100%，表示每 1 元销售额中可用于覆盖固定成本并形: Unit contribution margin ÷ price × 100%, the share of each 1 CNY of sales available to cover fixed cost and generate profit; with the default inputs it is 20 ÷ 50 = 40%.
map.降本后的利润提升怎么算？: How is the profit lift from cost reduction computed?
map.两个方案分别按「（单价 − 单位变动成本）× 预计销量 − 固定成本」计算利润，: Profit for each plan is (price − unit variable cost) × expected sales − fixed cost, and the difference is the lift; with the default inputs the optimized profit is 24 × 5,000 − 60,000 = 60,000 CNY, a lift of 20,000 CNY over the original 40,000 CNY.
